proves.claim: two nextSelection.pick calls on an unchanged seat checkout launch git status at most once between them and warm from the same files.

moves.selection.status-reused.why: Every next launched a git status even when HEAD, the index and the files items name were unchanged (#10859).

proves.claim: a first edit to a clean tracked file an open item in the seat lane names reaches the second pick's warm files, and the pick selects the same item.

moves.selection.edit-named-file-warms.why: Reusing the status must never hide an edit that can change which item is picked (#10859).

proves.claim: with ports.derivedGateAtHead returning a reader, nextSelection.pick passes it to nextFor, so an item the reader names as gated is not picked and the next free item is

moves.selection.derived-gate-port.why: Without this test, a regression where with ports.derivedGateAtHead returning a reader, nextSelection.pick passes it to nextFor, so an item the reader names as gated is not picked and the next free item is would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: with no derivedGateAtHead port, or a port returning null, nextSelection.pick returns the same item as before and no reader reaches nextFor

moves.selection.derived-gate-port-absent.why: Without this test, a regression where with no derivedGateAtHead port, or a port returning null, nextSelection.pick returns the same item as before and no reader reaches nextFor would pass unnoticed.
